text:
ana: Hey team — HarborBank POC kickoff. They require SSO (SAML via Okta), SCIM user + group provisioning, RBAC mapped to AD groups, domain allowlist, and EU data residency. Also asking for Dedicated capacity pricing for a 3-month POC and a security/RFI pack. Can SEs + ProdSec join a 10:00 CET kickoff tomorrow?

mike: I can join tomorrow. For SAML we'll need their IdP metadata and attribute mapping. Sharing our SAML quickstart: https://redwood.internal/presales/saml-quickstart :point_up:

jordan: For deployment options: Dedicated (FR/IE) or Private on-prem if they insist on air-gapped. Dedicated lead time ~2–3 weeks to provision reserved pool; for a fast POC we can do hosted with VPC peering + SCIM. Need to confirm whether SCIM should provision users only or groups+roles.

ana: they want groups + role mapping (so groups => redwood roles). also they mentioned <100ms 95th for short prompts, qps ~200 steady / 400 burst.

mike: Ok. Example SAML attribute and a simple mapping rule below — share with their IdP team: 

```
<saml:Attribute Name="groups">
  <saml:AttributeValue>cn=rbac-admins,ou=groups,dc=harbor,dc=com</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```

Mapping: `if groups contains "rbac-admins" => redwood_role = "admin"`

jordan: For latency SLOs, Dedicated sized correctly + concurrency config should hit their target. We'll include autoscale + fallback to smaller model variants in the playbook. Need real prompt length distribution to size memory / KV cache.

olivia: I'll prepare the commercial side. POC discount available — will DM a preliminary estimate for a 16-GPU reserved pool and a hosted fallback option. Note: SCIM provisioning generates API calls that count against rate limits unless we configure an internal sync client.

ana: Security RFI — they want SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS/customer-managed key support, detailed audit logs for SCIM/SSO events, and proof of data residency. @sara can you own the RFI?

sara: Taking it. I'll assemble answers for SAML/SCIM, RBAC mapping, encryption at rest (customer KMS), network controls (VPC peering, private endpoints), and logging/audit retention. Will need the contact info for their security lead and their questionnaire file (DOCX/PDF).

ana: I'll push their questionnaire to this thread in a min. Also they asked about domain-level allowlist for tenant isolation. Is that standard?

mike: We support domain allowlists per-tenant. For Dedicated we can enforce at the network and auth layer. For hosted we offer SSO domain verification + allowlist config.

jordan: Operational note — if they expect 400 burst with low latency, recommend GPU sizing + eager KV cache warmup. For POC we can enable a canary route to test traffic and measure 95th/99th latency.

olivia: Opening a PR for commercial terms and a POC statement of work (will link here).

sara: Also flag: they asked about SCIM audit trail retention policy. We currently keep SCIM provisioning logs for 90 days by default; we can extend for enterprise contracts. I'll include that in answers.

devbot: presales-playbook-bot: presales playbook doc updated (presales/harborbank-auth-checklist.md) :white_check_mark:

ana: Great — next actions: (1) mike + jordan join 10:00 CET kickoff tomorrow, (2) sara to own RFI, (3) olivia to share POC pricing draft, (4) ana to upload questionnaire and sample prompt traces. I'll post meeting invite now. Thanks all :pray:
